en-US.title: Bolo: Speak Hindi
en-US.subtitle: Real-life conversation skills
en-US.description:
Practice Hindi for the moments that happen in real life.

Bolo helps you move from recognizing words to choosing a natural response. Work through 21 guided scenes for cafés, transport, shopping, travel, work, social visits, and everyday errands. Health scenes are language exercises and do not provide medical advice.

GUIDED SCENES
• Read Hindi in Devanagari with transliteration and an English meaning
• Choose a response and get immediate feedback
• After consent, hear Hindi lines in Mira's AI voice
• Save useful phrases for quick review
• Track your daily practice and streak on your device

OPTIONAL COACHING WITH MIRA
After a separate consent step, use AI Listen, type a message, use GPT Realtime voice turns, or record pronunciation. Choose English or Hindi replies, tap the glowing orb to begin a voice turn, speak naturally, then tap the orb again to send. AI voice and connected coaching require an internet connection.

YOUR CHOICE
The 21 written guided scenes, saved phrases, and practice progress are available without an account or internet. AI features are optional, and consent can be withdrawn in Settings. AI replies can be reported from inside the app.

Bolo is a language-practice tool. AI responses may be inaccurate; do not rely on Bolo for professional translation, medical advice, or emergency help.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release with 21 guided Hindi scenes, saved phrases, daily practice tracking, consent-gated AI voice playback, and optional typed, live voice, translation, and pronunciation coaching with Mira.
en-US.promoText: Practice practical Hindi in 21 real-life scenes, then choose optional English-first coaching with Mira.

review.notes:
No account, login, purchase, or subscription is required. The 21 written guided scenes work without connected coaching.

To review AI voice in a scene, open a scene, accept the versioned AI data-use consent, and tap Listen. The audio is generated by the server AI voice; the app has no device text-reader fallback.

To review connected coaching, open Practice with Mira and accept the same consent if needed. Keep English selected, type ‘How do I say thank you?’, and verify an English reply with AI voice playback. Select हिन्दी, type the same question, and verify a Hindi reply. Tap the glowing orb; this requests microphone permission, opens a WebRTC media stream with its audio track initially disabled, and begins the turn. Tap the orb again to send. Microphone transmission is enabled only during an active turn, remains disabled between turns, and the stream is released at End, when leaving the screen, or when the app leaves the foreground. Live voice does not create a recording file or capture microphone audio in the background. Then switch to Live Translate to verify spoken Hindi becomes English text without translated audio. A scene answer can be recorded for pronunciation feedback. Generated live and pronunciation replies include a Report control.

Settings allows consent withdrawal and deletion of local data plus server reports linked to the app's random identifier. AI voice and connected coaching require internet access. Pharmacy and doctor scenes teach language phrasing and are not medical advice. Bolo does not record in the background.
